properties.content: Question: astrazeneca vacuna covid Answer: AstraZeneca has discontinued its COVID-19 vaccine, Vaxzevria, due to low sales, according to Contagion Live. The vaccine, also known as Covishield and developed in partnership with Oxford University, was a viral vector vaccine. AstraZeneca, in a statement on their website, noted that they had built 25 supply networks across 15 countries, delivering two billion doses and saving an estimated six million lives in the first year alone.

Question: astrazeneca vacuna covid

Answer: AstraZeneca has discontinued its COVID-19 vaccine, Vaxzevria, due to low sales, according to Contagion Live. The vaccine, also known as Covishield and developed in partnership with Oxford University, was a viral vector vaccine. AstraZeneca, in a statement on their website, noted that they had built 25 supply networks across 15 countries, delivering two billion doses and saving an estimated six million lives in the first year alone.
